audit.why: Lane difficulty reads correctly: Mel wins the level 2-3 poke window, Sion takes over from level 4 once E armour shred plus a partial charge beats her trade rhythm. 57.48% over 1818 games supports the content chart (Skill/Mel/Skill/Sion x4).

audit.whatIsWrong: Spikes were right in shape but vague on the enemy cooldowns that make them real windows.
audit.why: Level 6 Unstoppable Onslaught is the equaliser against a champion with no dash; Rebuttal is a 38s cooldown at rank 1, so the all-in window is defined by that spell, not by hers generally.
audit.corrected: Named Rebuttal and its 38s rank-1 cooldown in spikes[0] and spikes[1].

audit.whatIsWrong: The text repeatedly calls Mel's reflect her R ('her R-reflect', 'her R can reflect', 'Respect her R reflect', wants.foe[1] 'Use R to reflect'), and calls her zoning tool W. Both are wrong slots, and it also claims the reflect bounces Sion's charged Q.
audit.why: Rebuttal (W) is the reflect barrier; Golden Eclipse (R) is the global Overwhelm strike and reflects nothing. Solar Snare (E) is the root/slow zone. Decimating Smash (Q) is not a projectile, so it cannot be reflected — Roar of the Slayer (E, 800 range) is Sion's only projectile and is what Rebuttal actually eats.
audit.corrected: Rebuttal (W, 38/35/33/29/26s) reflects Roar of the Slayer back at you; Golden Eclipse strikes through Overwhelm stacks at any range; Solar Snare roots. Searing Brilliance (P) loads bonus projectiles on her next attack, so the auto wind-up is the burst tell, not the cast.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing told the player that each Mel ability cast loads her next auto-attack.
audit.why: Searing Brilliance grants three bonus projectiles per cast, up to nine — the damage arrives on the attack, which is when you disengage.

edits.before: Her ranged Q poke and W zone land freely at levels 2-3 while your charge time is fully exposed and your W-shield is still small; absorb and do not overcommit.
edits.after: Radiant Volley and Solar Snare land freely at levels 2-3, and each cast loads Searing Brilliance — the wind-up on her next attack is your cue to step back.

edits.before: Your full kit is online but her poke and R-reflect make charging in open lane punishing; bide time and deny her free damage with W-shield.
edits.after: Your full kit is online but Radiant Volley poke and Rebuttal's reflect punish charging in open lane; bait it, then Soul Furnace eats the follow-up.

edits.before: Mel’s ranged Q poke lands freely while your charged-Q telegraph is obvious and your W-shield is thin — her best window to build a lead.
edits.after: Radiant Volley lands freely while your Decimating Smash charge is telegraphed and Soul Furnace is still thin — her best window to build a lead.

edits.before: Unstoppable Onslaught closes the gap on a champion with no dash escape — land it from fog of war or after a slow and the all-in is clean.
edits.after: Unstoppable Onslaught closes the gap on a champion with no dash — bait Rebuttal (38s at rank 1) first, then charge from fog and the all-in is clean.

edits.before: At level 1 neither of you has a clear advantage, but Mel’s ranged Q poke starts to chip as soon as minions arrive — keep your W-shield available to eat one poke and immediately counter-charge your Q. At levels 2 and 3 she can freely deny your charged-Q setup by staying at max Q range and using her W to zone you off the wave; her poke rhythm beats your charge time during this window. Focus on last-hitting with the tip of your Q, build W-shield value by absorbing one poke and detonating it on the nearest minion, and do not hard-commit to a charged-Q unless she over-extends past a wall where the knockup is guaranteed.
edits.after: At level 1 neither of you has a clear advantage, but Radiant Volley starts to chip as soon as minions arrive — keep Soul Furnace available to eat one volley and immediately counter-charge your Q. At levels 2 and 3 she denies your charged-Q setup by holding max range and dropping Solar Snare to root you off the wave; her poke rhythm beats your charge time during this window. Focus on last-hitting with the tip of your Q, build Soul Furnace value by absorbing one poke and detonating it on the nearest minion, and do not hard-commit to a charged Q unless she over-extends past a wall where the knockup is guaranteed.

edits.before: Level 4 onward your short-trade pattern shifts in your favor: pop W-shield to eat her Q, then E to shred her armor and chase with a partially charged Q that at least slows and damages her even if not fully held. At level 6 your R is the equalizer — she has no dash, so an Unstoppable Onslaught from out of vision or around a terrain angle is nearly guaranteed to connect; once she is knocked up, your E-W-Q combo finishes the all-in before her R can reflect a second time. Track the reflect cooldown and all-in in the window when it is down.
edits.after: Level 4 onward your short-trade pattern shifts in your favor: pop Soul Furnace to eat Radiant Volley, then E to shred her armor and chase with a partially charged Q that at least slows and damages her even if not fully held. At level 6 your R is the equalizer — she has no dash, so an Unstoppable Onslaught from out of vision or around a terrain angle is nearly guaranteed to connect; once she is knocked up, your E-W-Q combo finishes the all-in before Rebuttal comes back up. Track Rebuttal (38s at rank 1) and all-in in the window when it is down.

edits.before: Two items in, your W-shield is scaling off an enormous HP total and your zombie passive forces her to burn spells just to finish the kill, letting your team follow up for free. Corner her in the side lane with terrain and she cannot outrun your R approach or kite your charged Q indefinitely. Respect her R reflect by never leading with a long-range missile all-in — walk into melee range with W active and let the shield eat her retaliatory poke, then close with charged-Q after E shreds her armor and she has nowhere to go.
edits.after: Two items in, Soul Furnace scales off an enormous HP total and Glory in Death forces her to burn spells just to finish the kill, letting your team follow up for free. Corner her in the side lane with terrain and she cannot outrun your R approach or kite your charged Q indefinitely. Respect Rebuttal — it reflects Roar of the Slayer straight back, so never open with it; walk in with Soul Furnace active, eat her retaliatory poke, then close with a charged Q once E has shredded her armor and she has nowhere to go.

edits.before: Use R to close distance from fog of war and bypass her R-reflect window by staying behind it
edits.after: Use R to close from fog of war after Rebuttal is spent — 38 seconds of it down at rank 1

edits.after: Use Rebuttal to reflect Roar of the Slayer back at you and block your damage while she resets the trade

edits.after: Zone you off CS with Solar Snare's root and Radiant Volley so you fall behind on HP stacks
